acceptedAnswer.text: An open standard governing how AI models discover, connect to, and execute external tools, data sources, and services.
Leading registries and discovery platforms for pre-built, community-verified Model Context Protocol servers.

mainEntity.name: How do you secure MCP servers in production?

acceptedAnswer.text: By restricting server permissions, avoiding root execution, validating schema inputs, and running servers in isolated containers.

mainEntity.name: Can you build custom MCP servers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The MCP TypeScript and Python SDKs make it straightforward to wrap any internal API or database in standard MCP endpoints.

mainEntity.name: Who governs the Model Context Protocol?

acceptedAnswer.text: The protocol is governed as an open-source standard under the Linux Foundation with multi-vendor participation.
